status: frozen before any prototype arm has trained; written after the single-channel attribution sweep completed (receipts/analysis/lucid_channel_attribution_20260902.json), which is what motivates it

adds.box_asym: box gate with per-channel ceilings {mass 2.0, CoM 2.0, joint 2.0, friction 1.5, push 1.5, latency 1.5}; probe capped at each channel's ceiling; otherwise identical to box_150
adds.ramp_asym: open-loop scalar frontier 1.0->2.0 over iterations 0-1500 with friction/push/latency capped at 1.5 through term_lambda_caps; same strata and probe geometry (M5 matched control for box_asym)
adds.fixed_asym: fixed lambda 2.0 with the same three caps from iteration 0, single stratum (width control)

corrections.why: the sweep measured mass/CoM/joint nearly free to 3x for trained policies and push binding (0.705-0.770 at 3x); a uniform 1.5 ceiling withholds width where it is free. These arms can EXCEED the 1.5 arms' support on three channels, so they are not compared with them on the scalar band without labelling.

asym_primary.support: outside every arm (asym ceilings are 2.0 on these channels)

asym_binding_channel.reading: reported: the asym arms hold push at 1.5 like the 1.5 arms, so a push difference is a side effect of widening the others, in either direction

adds.scalar_band_for_asym_arms: phys_175 and phys_200 are IN SUPPORT for box_asym/ramp_asym/fixed_asym on mass, CoM and joint offsets; reported, labelled, never gated on for those arms

adds.R6_box_asym_vs_ramp_asym: delta = asym_primary(box_asym) - asym_primary(ramp_asym). |delta| < 0.03: no feedback effect at this budget on the asymmetric box. delta >= +0.03: box_asym advances to one from-scratch cell against ramp_asym. delta <= -0.03: shelved and diagnosed offline, not re-run with a lower threshold.
adds.R7_asym_vs_uniform_width: informational: asym_primary(fixed_asym) - asym_primary(fixed_150) says what widening the cheap channels buys on their own cells; the 1.5 arms are outside support on those cells too, so the comparison is fair there and only there
adds.R3_extended: R3 (zero decreases) applies to every channel of frontier_vector for box_asym and to lambda for ramp_asym/fixed_asym
adds.R4_extended: R4 (mechanism) applies to box_asym: >= 3 channels visited and >= 1 expansion, else STALLED

corrections.now: 8 arms x ~1.3 GPU-h; the driver's default order runs the five uniform arms' decisive pairs first (box_150, gate_150, ramp_150) then the asym pair, then the fixed controls; trim with --modes

two batches, each scored before the next trains: batch 1 = box_150, gate_150, box_asym, ramp_asym, fixed_150 (the two decisive pairs and the width anchor); batch 2 = ramp_150, fixed, fixed_asym. Rules R1-R7 unchanged; R2 and R5/R7 are evaluated when batch 2 lands.
corrections.why: a first readout ~5 h earlier; the prototype trains beside a PAUSED Phase 2 trainer that holds ~6.7 GiB of GPU memory (Phase 2 amendment A9), which affects wall-clock only

not_claimed_added: that the asym ceilings are optimal: they are one reading of one seed's marginals, chosen before any asym arm trained
